analysis_scope: impact, root cause, mitigation, and residual risk

severity_rule.safety_significant: terminal outcome, escalation, fail-closed, human authority, evidence control, unsupported claim, or external-action failure
severity_rule.governance_significant: audit semantics, traceability classification, ownership, or remediation accountability mismatch with correct safety behavior

change_constraints: do not alter frozen v1.0.1 cases
do not alter expected outcomes or assertion severity
do not change model or evidence thresholds
do not conceal or edit P5-01 raw results
apply code-only evidence-supported refinements in P5-04
rerun the entire 19-case suite after refinement
production_boundary: Controlled capstone prototype; nonbinding recommendations only; no autonomous external action; final human authority required.
